name: Frederica Baumann
japaneseName: フレデリカ・バウマン
description: Frederica Baumann is the head maid of House Mathers and a loyal member of the Emilia Camp. Originally from the Sanctuary and the older half-sister of Garfiel Tinsel, she returned to active service at Roswaal Manor at the start of Arc 4, subsequently playing supporting roles in Arc 4, Arc 7, and Arc 8.
